_about.generatedBy: Slate Companion flag research; see FLAGS-SOURCES.md
_about.saveFormat: game_data.sav: 12-byte header (u32 version, 0xFFFFFFFF, 1), then 8-byte entries (u32 crc32(flag name), 4 value bytes), little endian on Switch. Arrays and strings repeat the same hash per element/word.
_about.hash: zlib/IEEE CRC32 of the ASCII flag name
_about.inSave: true when the flag hash is present in every test save; saveFile names caption.sav when it lives there

stats.label: Play time
stats.notes: Total play time in seconds; this is the flag Marc Robledo's editor reads as play time (there is no flag named PlayTime).

stats.label: Heart containers
stats.notes: Stored in quarter hearts: divide by 4 (starts at 12 = 3 hearts).

stats.label: Current health
stats.notes: Health at save time in quarter hearts; can exceed max when yellow bonus hearts are active.

stats.label: Stamina
stats.notes: Float; 1000.0 is one full wheel, so wheels = value / 1000 (each vessel adds 200).

stats.label: Korok seeds found
stats.notes: Count of Koroks found (max 900); seeds still held are the Obj_KorokNuts item in PorchItem.

stats.label: Spirit orbs held
stats.notes: Unspent spirit orbs; matches the Obj_DungeonClearSeal inventory count in the test saves.

stats.label: Shrines cleared
stats.notes: Counter of completed shrines (max 255 in game data); meaning inferred from name and test-save values.

stats.label: Blood Moon timer
stats.notes: Timer toward the next Blood Moon; there is no saved count of Blood Moons.

stats.label: Great Fairies revived
stats.notes: Max 4 in game data; name suggests number of Great Fairy fountains reopened.

stats.label: Overworld Talus bosses defeated
stats.notes: Counts distinct named Stone Talus spawns (the editor's Talus counter).

stats.label: Overworld Hinox bosses defeated
stats.notes: Counts distinct Hinox spawns (the editor's Hinox counter).

stats.label: Overworld Molduga bosses defeated
stats.notes: Counts distinct Molduga spawns (the editor's Molduga counter).

stats.label: Last save time (low word)
stats.notes: Also stored in caption.sav; combine with LastSaveTime_Upper.

stats.label: Last save time (high word)
stats.notes: High half of the save timestamp.

stats.label: Distance travelled
stats.notes: No saved distance counter was found (App_Pedometer_StepCount exists but is 0 in all test saves).

stats.label: Blood Moons seen
stats.notes: No Blood Moon count exists in game data.

inventory.description: PorchItem is a String64 array of 420 slots: each slot is 16 consecutive entries with the same hash, holding the item actor name as raw bytes (NUL padded). Slots are filled from 0 with no gaps and the first empty name ends the list. Items are grouped in pouch order: weapons, bows, arrows, shields, armor, materials, food, key items. PorchItem_Value1 (s32 array, 420) and PorchItem_EquipFlag (bool array, 420) are parallel arrays indexed by the same slot number. Value1 means: weapon/bow/shield durability x100; arrow, material, food and key-item count; armor dye colour index (0 = default, -1 for armor that cannot be dyed). EquipFlag is 1 for equipped items. Bonus modifiers live in separate arrays indexed by the n-th weapon, n-th bow and n-th shield in pouch order (not by slot). Cooked-dish effects live in CookEffect0/1 indexed by the n-th food item.
inventory.checkedAgainst: Read-only check of the provided Switch 1.9.0 test saves (rev 0x4730): 138 filled slots, layout as described.

PorchItem.notes: Item actor names; 16 entries per slot.

PorchItem_Value1.notes: Durability x100, count, or dye index (see description).

PorchSword_FlagSp.notes: Modifier bit flags for the n-th weapon.

PorchSword_ValueSp.notes: Modifier value for the n-th weapon.

PorchBow_FlagSp.notes: Modifier bit flags for the n-th bow.

PorchBow_ValueSp.notes: Modifier value for the n-th bow.

PorchShield_FlagSp.notes: Modifier bit flags for the n-th shield.

PorchShield_ValueSp.notes: Modifier value for the n-th shield.

CookEffect0.notes: Per food item: x = effect id (-1 none), y = effect level; partly inferred.

CookEffect1.notes: Per food item: x appears to be health restored; meaning of fields partly inferred.

IsOpenItemCategory.notes: Which pouch tabs have been unlocked.

modifierBits.0x80000000: Set together with a bit to mark the yellow (plus) version

armorUpgrades.description: Armor upgrade level is not a separate flag: each upgrade replaces the item in PorchItem with a different actor name. ActorInfo gives each armor an armorStarNum (1 = base, 5 = four stars) and an armorNextRankName (the actor it becomes after the next Great Fairy upgrade). Upgrade level = armorStarNum - 1. Example: Armor_001_Head (base) -> Armor_002_Head -> Armor_003_Head -> Armor_004_Head -> Armor_015_Head (4 stars).

compendium.description: Per compendium entry there are three saved flags keyed by the actor name: IsRegisteredPictureBook_<Actor> (bool, entry registered), IsNewPictureBook_<Actor> (bool, still marked new/unviewed) and PictureBookSize_<Actor> (s32, -1 when no photo is stored). The photos themselves are JPG files named <Actor>.jpg in the pict_book folder next to the save slots, shared by all slots.

position.description: Three consecutive f32 entries (x, y = height, z) in map units; also PlayerSavePosAngleYDegree (f32 facing), PlayerSavePosMapName (string32, e.g. map section like D-6) and PlayerSavePosMapType (string32, e.g. MainField).
